overview: Ladders with real rails and rungs that stand up wherever you put them, with no wall needed behind, and a rope ladder that unrolls itself down a drop.

1.0.3: A rope ladder used on a rope ladder carries on down from its bottom rung instead of hanging beside it.
1.0.2: Release notes rewritten to read plainly; nothing in play changes.
1.0.0: A ladder is two rails and four rungs with depth, not one flat picture.
Cut from vanilla's own texture, so resource packs still retexture it.
It holds itself up in open air.
Six string and a stick make two rope ladders.
They unroll rung by rung down the drop below them, with the sound of it.
